title: Help for Healthcare Workers to Stay and Build Their Careers in Public Sector
what_it_is: Help for Healthcare Workers to Stay and Build Their Careers in Public Sector

sections.label: Redesigning administrative healthcare worker roles
sections.summary: MOH developed expanded Care Support Associate and Patient Service Associate roles, rolled out with training support, to give administrative and support healthcare workers more career progression.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: For administrative and support healthcare workers, we pay special attention to redesign their roles and career pathways so that they have more development and career progression opportunities.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: MOH has worked with the clusters to develop the Care Support Associate (CSA) and Patient Service Associate (PSA) roles, which incorporate an expanded mix of patient caregiving, administrative and operational tasks.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: This is currently being rolled out, with training support available, to enable existing staff to take up the expanded roles.

sections.label: No ANGEL scheme extension
sections.summary: The ANGEL scheme, meant specifically for nurses, has not been extended, as different healthcare groups take different approaches based on recruitment, competition and job nature.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: I know that he has also raised this question separately.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: We have not extended the ANGEL scheme, which was specifically meant for nurses, because we take different approaches.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: We do not have the same scheme for nurses and doctors, for example.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: We do take into account factors, such as the strength of the recruitment pipeline, the global competition, the nature of the jobs and their career structure and looking at what is needed for that particular role and that particular healthcare group.

sections.label: Supporting all public healthcare workers
sections.summary: Salaries of all public healthcare workers are regularly reviewed for fairness and competitiveness, with measures to attract, retain and support them.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: We do consider the needs of all our healthcare workers and, indeed, the administrative and support healthcare workers are as important to us, but we do it in a different way.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: We regularly review the salaries of all the healthcare workers in the public healthcare institutions to ensure that their salaries are fair and competitive.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: And we will continue to look at various ways to attract and retain them, various measures to ensure that they are future-ready, that we are supporting mid-entry entrants, for example, into the sector, providing them with opportunities to have job redesign, career development and also ensuring that they have a conducive and age-appropriate work environment.
